pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with a clear single design (escape the LIKE metacharacters). The PR states the behaviour change. No spec is needed.
No spec file in the change.

The new tests cover % and _ and the backslash, and the % case would have listed every item before the fix. I did not run them, because the Workers vitest pool is not in my allowed commands. Left to CI.
The diff touches no docs, and no docs mention the search's LIKE behaviour.
The escape regex covers \, % and _. The ESCAPE clause is a single backslash after JS string unescaping. The query stays parameterised. The only LIKE in src is this one.
The input is still bound as a parameter, so there is no injection. Escaping removes the wildcard-matching behaviour.
The diff touches no UI files. The page markup is unchanged.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: the escaping and the new tests. The "five items" figure is consistent with 3 seeded items plus 2 inserted by the test.
